visualCharacteristics.purpose: Slim dark rounded callout bar: message left, single action right
observed: Dark rounded bar: highlighted 'Not sure which plan is right for you?' + text | phone CTA 'Call 1-855-393-3302'
Dark teal rounded bar: 'Choose your internet plan, then add the EasyCare option ... Log in to My Viasat to add EasyCare.' | button 'Shop internet plans'

contentPattern.structure: one row: [message (strong highlight + text, inline links allowed) | link/button (e.g. ":phone: Call 1-855-393-3302" -> tel:)]

reuseGuidance: Author as "Columns Callout". The cell holding only links gets .columns-callout-action-col. Panel color differences (navy vs teal) belong to the design pass.
